prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.bookmarkletHint: Drag this link to your bookmarks bar
prefs.ytBookmarkletHint: Drag to your bookmarks bar — saves a YouTube video's transcript
prefs.browserExtensionHint: Save the page you're reading from your browser's toolbar
prefs.corsProxyTooltip: CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) is a security feature that prevents websites from making requests to different domains. We need it to save articles from external websites. Using your own proxy can be more reliable and faster than public ones.
prefs.afterExternalSaveHint: What to do after saving an article from a bookmarklet
prefs.enableSyncTooltip: Allows you to sync your articles across devices using a cloud service
prefs.syncIntervalHint: How often to poll for remote changes
prefs.autoHideHeaderHint: Automatically hide the header when scrolling down in articles
prefs.enableSummarizationTooltip: Generate a summary when saving an article, using a language model from the provider you choose — a cloud service or your own server.
prefs.summariesOn: Summaries will be generated for new articles

apiKeyHint.groq: Get a free key at console.groq.com
apiKeyHint.custom: Optional — most local servers don't need a key

prefs.enterApiKeyFirst: Please enter an API key first
prefs.enterServerUrlFirst: Please enter a server URL first
prefs.customPromptHint: Replaces the settings above. Use {text} for the article text.
prefs.customPromptPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the settings above
prefs.readingSpeedDefault: {{wpm}} words/min (default — read some articles to personalize)
prefs.statsGpc: Disabled by your browser's Global Privacy Control signal. Savr honors that, so this setting is ignored while it's on.
prefs.statsOn: Sends anonymous counts (app opens, captures, installs) and your country. No account, no article URLs or content. Respects Global Privacy Control.
prefs.statsOff: Off — no usage data is collected.
prefs.publishPublicExportHint: Publishes a public read-only copy of your Savr database JSON through your RemoteStorage provider. This file may include deleted records if they exist in your database.
prefs.publicExportDeleteFailed: Export disabled but failed to delete remote file: {{error}}
prefs.publicExportUrlUnavailable: URL: not available for this provider
prefs.deleteAllHint: Permanently remove all articles from the database
prefs.deleteAllHintConnected: Disconnect from remote storage first to delete all articles
prefs.deleteConfirmBody_one: Are you sure you want to delete all {{count}} article? This action cannot be undone.
prefs.deleteConfirmBody_other: Are you sure you want to delete all {{count}} articles? This action cannot be undone.
